title: Counters Expert - 6-Day
description: The complete defensive system. Master the full Contre Jab Cross (13) and Contre Jab Hook (27) series.

days.notes: Review Jab-Cross series. Ensure perfect timing and structure for all 13 counters.
Review intermediate Jab-Hook counters. Focus on closing distance.
COUNTERS 15-20 (Jab-Hook): Defensive responses to LEFT HOOK attacks. Shoulder stops, biceps stops, John Wayne.
Rest day. Review the technical differences between Right and Left Hook defenses.
COUNTERS 21-27 (Jab-Hook): Advanced kicking ripostes and trapping flows for Left Hook. Full series complete.
FULL SERIES: Flow through all 27 Jab-Hook defensive responses.

Author: Antoine Giniès
